poc_summary: Customer will run a 14-day Dedicated POC. Goal: validate steady-state p50 latency <= 80ms for chat support workload at 200 concurrent users, and end-to-end cost metrics. POC infra: 4 x A10G equivalent nodes, autoscale for bursts. Canary: route 10% of real traffic to Dedicated; fallback: hosted_api small model (rwd-3b) in same region. Metrics for rollback: error rate >2% over 10m or p50 latency degradation >60% vs baseline.
notes: Customer started on hosted API to evaluate dev ergonomics; liked SDK and streaming support.
CTO (A. Mehra): 'Need predictable cost and control; we cannot tolerate regional blackouts.'
SE Carlos: POC checklist includes VPC peering, KMS key policy, SAML test user and load script (k6).
Security: asked about audit log retention (12 months) and ability to push logs to customer SIEM.
Operations: want canary at 10% for 72h then 30% for 48h before full cutover; require automated rollback hook.
Finance: preferred committed monthly capacity with burst; requested a worked example for 250M tokens/month.
Legal: still negotiating data residency clause for EU customers — may require region pinning for some tenant datasets.
POC success criteria: latency SLOs met, failover verified (region + model variant), documented cost per 1k tokens under target threshold.
canary_and_routing_plan: Phase 1: Canary 10% traffic -> Dedicated (rwd-13b-ptq model variant); monitoring for 72 hours. Phase 2: Increase to 30% if SLOs pass. Fallback: immediate routing to hosted_api rwd-3b in same region on error spike or latency breach. Region failover: if eu-west-1 Dedicated cluster unhealthy for >5m, route EU traffic to hosted API eu region and notify. Rollback criteria: >2% error rate sustained 10m OR p50 latency >150ms OR user-facing regression in conversation quality flagged by sample evals.
technical_requirements_and_assumptions: VPC peering + private endpoints, customer-managed KMS key (will grant Redwood service account encrypt/decrypt), SSO via SAML 2.0 with SCIM provisioning (optional), support for quantized model variants (ptq) and ability to pin model version per route.
pricing_discussion_notes: Offered two paths: 1) committed Dedicated monthly at tiered throughput (base + burst) with discount vs hosted; 2) hybrid: hosted for failover + Dedicated commit for steady traffic. Finance asked for an example invoice for 6-month commit.
